title: Homogeneous nonlinear phase and basin atlas
question: What are the nonlinear turnover scale, phase-transition order, multistable basins, and conservative lifetime of the homogeneous Nulloth coherence sector?
prediction: All fifteen activated growing-mode seeds turn over at the quartic energy root while remaining bounded; the equilibrium branches emerge continuously with no hysteresis; two sign basins are separated by the stationary symmetric state; and reduced energy is conserved through the 100-unit basin runs.
falsifier: An unbounded run, a turnover mismatch above 1e-6, a resolved hysteresis loop or first-order jump, basin sign crossing, motion of the exact symmetric boundary, or energy drift above 1e-10 falsifies the map.
controls: The scalar ODE is the exact homogeneous reduction of the implemented first-order scalar RHS with frozen material.
Every measured turnover amplitude is compared with the independent conserved-energy root.
The representative turnover time is repeated at time steps 0.004, 0.002, and 0.001.
Upward and downward carrier-density equilibrium sweeps test hysteresis without changing the canonical potential.
Positive, negative, and exactly zero seeds test the two basins and their symmetric boundary.
The word saturation is restricted to the first nonlinear turning scale because no damping is present.
seed_rationale: The carrier-density, amplitude, equilibrium, and basin sweeps are deterministic.
